plan.notes: Source: 'BBA/MBA Business Administration 4+1 Program - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog'. The catalog does not publish specific MBA course titles in this plan: Spring Semester 8, the Summer term, Fall Semester 9, and Spring Semester 10 list only 'MBA Graduate Course(s)' placeholders, kept here verbatim (choice=true, advisor/MBA-program determined) - no MBA course names were invented. Catalog total: 'Total hours required for major - 120 hours (BBA), 30 hours (MBA), 150 hours (total)'. Per-semester totals printed by the catalog (15/16/16/15/15/15/16/18/6/9/9) match the sequenced course sums; sequenced sum = 150. Catalog note: 'Please see admission criteria for the BBA/MBA 4+1 program.' 'Major Course Requirement' slots are major choice placeholders; course options are determined with the advisor under the 4+1 program curriculum. Catalog labels the sequence Fall/Spring/Summer; terms are sequenced 1-11 in printed order.
